authoredProduction: Elm and Haskell only; all GUI Elm; compiler-generated HTML/JS separately pinned; no authored JS strings or adapter

transport.policy: shared pure DesktopPolicy/Bar/Popup transitions, one interpreter selected by pinned artifact; no simultaneously active ports and HTTP
transport.origins: three exact distinct 127.0.0.1 ephemeral TCP listeners, role fixed by accepted listener, never body/header/path-selected
transport.urls: exact raw route allowlist, no query/fragment/percent/path normalization, filesystem mapping, fallback, redirect or wildcard CORS
transport.headers: HTTP/1.1, exact Host including port; every POST requires exact same-role Origin and application/json, finite exact Content-Length; no transfer-encoding/duplicate headers/extra bytes
transport.controller: whole checked viewProtocol1 view-commit bytes forwarded once on inherited fd0 by original authenticated PID, no request extraction
transport.renderer: existing typed action accepted only as renderer provenance; never accepts native-event, topology, disposition, dismiss, escape or reflow tags
transport.native: only checked current-binding backend fd0 gateway becomes native-event; typed native owner callback is separate from HTTP
transport.delivery: HTTP response only means transport receipt; never presentation/disposition/native effect ACK; no replay after ambiguous mutation or deadline renewal
transport.apiReadIsolation: Every API request including consuming GET /events requires X-Warlock-Api: 1. Cross-origin browser API fetch triggers forbidden OPTIONS preflight; image/navigation/simple GET cannot dequeue events. Exact Origin still required on POST and whenever present on GET; no CORS.

assets.source: held resolveSnapshot + prepareHtml exact compiler standalone wrapper and immutable script/style hashes
assets.mapping: one exact index.html per role, all documents pinned before listener publication
assets.csp: default deny; exact script/style SHA256, connect only exact same-role origin; deny eval/unapproved inline/remote/frame/object/base/form/worker; no unsafe-eval or unsafe-inline scripts

webKit.target: WebKitGTK6 GTK4, actual Haskell native C APIs and pinned ABI inventory
webKit.navigation: explicit decide-policy handler defaults deny and only allows own exact packaged index; deny newwindow and download
webKit.resources: real blocking compiled WebKitUserContentFilter installed before load plus CSP; resource-load-started/sent-request are notifications, NOT denial hooks
webKit.sandbox: required renderer sandbox/private networking stays enabled; no software fallback or native device retry

lifecycle.deadline: caller original absolute D unchanged, existing Backend <=30s remains bounded; no persistent desktop acceptance
lifecycle.owners: bracket 3 listeners, IPC, queue workers, immutable assets, GUI/filter refs and callbacks; bounded queues and owned cleanup
lifecycle.startup: must fail closed without actual private-network ownership/configured pinned engine dependencies; no host-network fallback
lifecycle.nativeState: do not fabricate initial topology/window snapshot, view-disposition or binding grants; callback requires actual owning observation
lifecycle.retainedBatches: existing16 bound remains explicit until actual presentation dispositions exist
lifecycle.nativeFd: Inherited fd0 set CLOEXEC before engine subprocess startup; same original approved UI owner PID is the only writer.

retrofitting.boundary: existing Main/Bar/Popup port-policy coupling and held document route
retrofitting.existingAcceptance: ARC003/DEL011 historical source tuple retained; changed tuples need requalification
retrofitting.change: extract shared pure policy and add static HTTP transport, approved Haskell host owner
retrofitting.deferred: native topology/effect authority and full presentation lifecycle remain original obligations

acceptance.ARC024: all original clauses and architecture-024 require source-bound retained native OR bridge denial trace plus packaged asset route; HTTP-only subset not automatic whole closure
acceptance.DEL014: exact CSP and real engine remote/eval/inline execution-negative evidence required, headers alone insufficient
acceptance.native: HOSTSTOP2 and previous stops unchanged; this contract authorizes no retry or privilege attempt
